scope: Sanitized copies of executed ignored probe scripts. Current scripts reproduce corrected scopes; superseded prototype/first-boundary script bytes are not claimed available.
reproduction: Extract each content string into its listed ignored path, replace <repo> with a maintained local checkout, retain pinned Pester5.7.1 for focused tests, and select local PS5.1/PS7 executables. Redacted paths and LF normalization change script bytes; verify the separately recorded sanitizedContentSha256, not the original rawSha256. Use a new scratch directory. Run the named scripts with PowerShell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File. Transport runners create owned synthetic recorder sandboxes only.

scripts.content:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='<repo>'
$root=Join-Path $repo ('.wac-local\WAC-M3-02\transport-boundaries-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
[void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($root)
$rows=@()
foreach ($case in @('raw7599','raw7600','raw9000','count1024','count1025')) {
    $folder=Join-Path $root $case
    [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($folder)
    foreach ($name in @('WinAudioClean.bat','WinAudioClean.Launcher.ps1')) { [IO.File]::Copy((Join-Path $repo $name),(Join-Path $folder $name)) }
    [IO.File]::Copy((Join-Path $repo '.wac-local\WAC-M3-02\LauncherMainProbe.ps1'),(Join-Path $folder 'WinAudioClean.ps1'))
    $prefix='/d /s /c ""'+(Join-Path $folder 'WinAudioClean.bat')+'"'
    if ($case.StartsWith('raw')) {
        $target=[int]$case.Substring(3)
        # ProcessStartInfo quotes its executable; CMDCMDLINE retains those quotes.
        $cmdPath=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\cmd.exe'
        $fill=$target-$cmdPath.Length-3-$prefix.Length-4
        $arguments=$prefix+' "'+('a'*$fill)+'""'
        $expectedCount=1
    } else {
        $expectedCount=[int]$case.Substring(5)
        $arguments=$prefix+(' "a"'*$expectedCount)+'"'
    }
    $info=[Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
    $info.FileName=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\cmd.exe'; $info.Arguments=$arguments
    $info.UseShellExecute=$false; $info.RedirectStandardOutput=$true; $info.RedirectStandardError=$true; $info.RedirectStandardInput=$true
    $info.EnvironmentVariables['WAC_PROBE_RECORD']=Join-Path $folder 'record.json'
    $info.EnvironmentVariables['WAC_PROBE_EXIT']='7'
    $info.EnvironmentVariables['WAC_LAUNCH_IGNORE_SAVED_SETTINGS']='1'
    foreach ($name in @('WAC_LAUNCH_POWERSHELL','WAC_LAUNCH_INPUT','WAC_LAUNCH_INPUT_LIST_PATH','WAC_LAUNCH_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY','WAC_LAUNCH_SETTINGS_PATH')) { $info.EnvironmentVariables.Remove($name) }
    $process=[Diagnostics.Process]::new(); $process.StartInfo=$info; [void]$process.Start()
    $process.StandardInput.WriteLine(''); $process.StandardInput.Close()
    $outTask=$process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(); $errTask=$process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    if (-not $process.WaitForExit(30000)) { $process.Kill(); throw 'Boundary probe timed out.' }
    $exitCode=$process.ExitCode; $stdout=$outTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult(); $stderr=$errTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult(); $process.Dispose()
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $folder 'stdout.txt'),$stdout,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $folder 'stderr.txt'),$stderr,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $recordPath=Join-Path $folder 'record.json'; $expectedRecord=$case -in @('raw7599','count1024')
    $hasRecord=[IO.File]::Exists($recordPath)
    $countPass=$true; $rawLength=$null
    if ($hasRecord) { $record=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($recordPath,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8)|ConvertFrom-Json; $countPass=@($record.inputs).Count -eq $expectedCount; $rawLength=$record.originalCmd.Length }
    $pass=($hasRecord -eq $expectedRecord) -and $countPass -and $(if ($expectedRecord) {$exitCode -eq 7} elseif ($case -eq 'raw9000') {$exitCode -ne 0} else {$exitCode -eq 2})
    $rows += [ordered]@{case=$case; exitCode=$exitCode; record=$hasRecord; exactCount=$countPass; observedRawLength=$rawLength; pass=$pass; command=($info.FileName+' '+$arguments); folder=$folder}
    Write-Host "$case exit=$exitCode record=$hasRecord pass=$pass"
}
$result=[ordered]@{sourceHashes=@{bat=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path $repo 'WinAudioClean.bat')).Hash; launcher=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path $repo 'WinAudioClean.Launcher.ps1')).Hash; probe=(Get-FileHash $PSCommandPath).Hash}; cases=$rows; passed=@($rows|Where-Object pass).Count; failed=@($rows|Where-Object{-not $_.pass}).Count}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root 'results.json'),($result|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Write-Host ('Evidence: '+$root)
if ($result.failed) {exit 1}; exit 0

$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='<repo>'
$root=Join-Path $repo ('.wac-local\WAC-M3-02\worker-start-failure-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
[void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($root)
$rows=@()
foreach ($outerHost in @("$env:SystemRoot\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe",(Get-Command pwsh).Source)) {
    $folder=Join-Path $root ([IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($outerHost))
    [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($folder)
    foreach($name in @('WinAudioClean.bat','WinAudioClean.Launcher.ps1')) { [IO.File]::Copy((Join-Path $repo $name),(Join-Path $folder $name)) }
    [IO.File]::Copy((Join-Path $repo '.wac-local\WAC-M3-02\LauncherMainProbe.ps1'),(Join-Path $folder 'WinAudioClean.ps1'))
    $badWorker=Join-Path $folder 'invalid image.exe'
    [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($badWorker,[byte[]](0,1,2,3))
    $info=[Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new(); $info.FileName=$outerHost
    $info.Arguments='-NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "'+(Join-Path $repo '.wac-local\WAC-M3-02\Invoke-TransportProbe.ps1')+'" -Folder "'+$folder+'" -Case single -InnerPowerShell "'+$badWorker+'"'
    $info.UseShellExecute=$false; $info.RedirectStandardInput=$true; $info.RedirectStandardOutput=$true; $info.RedirectStandardError=$true
    $process=[Diagnostics.Process]::new(); $process.StartInfo=$info; [void]$process.Start()
    $process.StandardInput.WriteLine('');$process.StandardInput.Close()
    $outTask=$process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(); $errTask=$process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    if(-not $process.WaitForExit(30000)){$process.Kill();throw 'Worker-start probe timed out.'}
    $exitCode=$process.ExitCode;$stdout=$outTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult();$stderr=$errTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult();$process.Dispose()
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $folder 'stdout.txt'),$stdout,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $folder 'stderr.txt'),$stderr,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    $hasRecord=[IO.File]::Exists((Join-Path $folder 'record.json'));$pauseCount=([regex]::Matches($stdout,'Press any key')).Count
    $pass=$exitCode -eq 3 -and -not $hasRecord -and $pauseCount -eq 1
    $rows+=[ordered]@{host=$outerHost;exitCode=$exitCode;applicationRecord=$hasRecord;pauseCount=$pauseCount;pass=$pass;command=($info.FileName+' '+$info.Arguments);folder=$folder}
    Write-Host "$outerHost exit=$exitCode app=$hasRecord pause=$pauseCount pass=$pass"
}
$result=[ordered]@{sourceHashes=@{bat=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path $repo 'WinAudioClean.bat')).Hash;launcher=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path $repo 'WinAudioClean.Launcher.ps1')).Hash;probe=(Get-FileHash $PSCommandPath).Hash};cases=$rows;passed=@($rows|Where-Object pass).Count;failed=@($rows|Where-Object{-not $_.pass}).Count}
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root 'results.json'),($result|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Write-Host ('Evidence: '+$root)
if($result.failed){exit 1};exit 0

param([string]$Repository)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module (Join-Path $Repository '.wac-local/Modules/Pester/5.7.1/Pester.psd1') -Force
Write-Output ('Focused shell: ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion)
$result = Invoke-Pester -Path (Join-Path $Repository 'tests/WinAudioClean.LauncherTransport.Tests.ps1') -Output Detailed -PassThru
if ($result.TotalCount -eq 0 -or $result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedContainersCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedBlocksCount -gt 0) { exit 1 }
exit 0
